desc: Build adjacency lists containing both the neighboring vertex and edge XOR value.
Traverse every unvisited vertex, assigning XOR potentials and detecting inconsistent constraints.
For each connected component, count set and unset bits of all potentials across sufficient bit positions.
Construct the optimal component offset \(T\) bit-by-bit and output \(A_v=D_v\oplus T\).
Implement efficient input parsing and iterative traversal suitable for \(N\le 2\cdot10^5\) and \(M\le10^5\).
